title: macOS: Fix universal export using the wrong template build
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #124744

Universal macOS exports inverted which template binaries they kept. `--export-release` packaged the debug `.arm64` and `.x86_64` slices, and `--export-debug` packaged the release slices. Single-architecture exports were unaffected.

`EditorExportPlatformMacOS::export_project` skips template entries that are not the selected build. The universal branch introduced in #124408 skipped files that *did* match `binary_to_use_base` (`godot_macos_release.` or `godot_macos_debug.`). This negates that test so both architecture slices of the requested build are kept and the other build is skipped, matching the non-universal branch.

## Additional information

Use of AI: an autonomous coding assistant (Cursor, Grok) located the inverted `begins_with` check from issue #124744, applied the one-line condition change, and opened this pull request on behalf of Bit-Byte5. The diagnosis and the proposed negation come from the issue report; the change was not otherwise verified by running a macOS export locally.
